input.rationale: Section 4 deals only with the term, notice of termination and the Termination Payment; Section 10.7 (Survival) preserves Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 only. Nothing in the Agreement requires HDI, which hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and order data, to provide any transition assistance, to return or export that data on expiry or termination, or to delete it afterwards. In a hosting agreement this absence is a deviation from the rule, so we insert a short Section 4.3 at the preferred level: up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. A 90-day assistance period with the same 30-day export is the acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion clause in Section 4
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement ends with no exit mechanics, so we have added a short Section 4.3: HDI provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our Content and data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty days of expiry or termination, and certifies deletion after that return. If six months is too long, we can accept a 90-day assistance period with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) provide the Company with transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, return to the Company all Content, user information and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete such Content, user information and data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to the Company.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
